ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit pre-encryption recovery sabotage chain (vssadmin + bcdedit + wbadmin within 5 min)
ucs.description: Hunts the signature LockBit (G0017 / aka LockBit 2.0 / 3.0 / Black / Green / 5.0) pre-encryption sequence documented in CISA AA23-165A: rapid back-to-back invocation of vssadmin/wmic shadow deletion, bcdedit boot-recovery tampering, and wbadmin backup destruction. LockBit's encryptor stub runs these as a fixed command block before the cryptor pass, so 3+ tools firing on the same host inside a 5-minute window is an extremely high-fidelity ransomware-imminent signal.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe") by _time Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process span=1m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval activity=case(
    process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND match(lower(process), "delete\s+shadows"), "vss_shadow_delete",
    process_name="wmic.exe" AND match(lower(process), "shadowcopy\s+delete"), "wmic_shadow_delete",
    process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND match(lower(process), "recoveryenabled|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures"), "bcdedit_recovery_disable",
    process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND match(lower(process), "delete\s+(catalog|backup|systemstatebackup)"), "wbadmin_backup_destroy",
    true(), null())
| where isnotnull(activity)
| bin _time span=5m
| stats min(_time) AS first_seen max(_time) AS last_seen dc(activity) AS distinct_activities values(activity) AS activities values(process) AS commands values(parent_process_name) AS parents by dest user _time
| where distinct_activities >= 3
| convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
| sort - first_seen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMinutes = 5m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete", "shadows"))
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy", "delete"))
     or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled" or ProcessCommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy"))
     or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and (ProcessCommandLine has "catalog" or ProcessCommandLine has "backup" or ProcessCommandLine has "systemstatebackup"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Activity = case(
    FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe", "vss_shadow_delete",
    FileName =~ "wmic.exe", "wmic_shadow_delete",
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled", "bcdedit_recovery_disable",
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy", "bcdedit_bootstatus_ignore",
    FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe", "wbadmin_backup_destroy",
    "other")
| summarize
    FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
    LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
    DistinctActivities = dcount(Activity),
    Activities = make_set(Activity),
    Commands   = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
    Parents    = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 10),
    Users      = make_set(AccountName, 5)
    by DeviceName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
| where DistinctActivities >= 3   // 3+ destructive tools in 5min = LockBit/ransomware-imminent
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, DeviceName, DistinctActivities, Activities, Users, Parents, Commands
| order by FirstSeen desc

#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(vssadmin|wmic|bcdedit|wbadmin)\.exe$/i
| (
    (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND regex("(?i)delete\\s+shadows", field=CommandLine))
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND regex("(?i)shadowcopy\\s+delete", field=CommandLine))
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND regex("(?i)(recoveryenabled|bootstatuspolicy\\s+ignoreallfailures)", field=CommandLine))

ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit Safe-Mode reboot persistence trick (bcdedit safeboot + RunOnce + shutdown /r)
ucs.description: Hunts LockBit 3.0's signature anti-AV evasion: the encryptor invoked with `-safemode` flag rewrites BCD with `bcdedit /set {current} safeboot network`, plants a RunOnce/SafeBoot registry value to relaunch itself with the unique `-pass <key>` argument, then issues `shutdown /r /t 0` to force a reboot into Safe Mode where most EDR/AV agents don't load. The three-step chain on a single host inside ~10 minutes is uniquely LockBit (documented by Sophos and Mandiant on LockBit 3.0 / Black incidents).
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe Processes.process="*safeboot*" by _time Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| rename _time AS safeboot_time process AS safeboot_cmd parent_process_name AS safeboot_parent
| join type=inner dest [
    | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=shutdown.exe (Processes.process="*/r*" OR Processes.process="*-r*") by _time Processes.dest Processes.process
    | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
    | rename _time AS shutdown_time process AS shutdown_cmd
  ]
| where shutdown_time >= safeboot_time AND shutdown_time <= safeboot_time + 600
| eval delay_sec = shutdown_time - safeboot_time
| convert ctime(safeboot_time) ctime(shutdown_time)
| table safeboot_time shutdown_time delay_sec dest user safeboot_parent safeboot_cmd shutdown_cmd
| sort - safeboot_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
let SafeBootProc = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project SafeBootTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              SafeBootCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              SafeBootParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              SafeBootParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let ShutdownProc = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where FileName =~ "shutdown.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/r", "-r")
    | project ShutdownTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, ShutdownCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let SafeBootReg = DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where (RegistryKey has @"\SafeBoot\Network\" or RegistryKey has @"\SafeBoot\Minimal\")
         or (RegistryKey has @"\CurrentVersion\RunOnce" and isnotempty(RegistryValueData))
    | project RegTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RegKey = RegistryKey, RegVal = RegistryValueData;
SafeBootProc
| join kind=inner ShutdownProc on DeviceId
| where ShutdownTime between (SafeBootTime .. SafeBootTime + WindowMinutes)
| join kind=leftouter (SafeBootReg) on DeviceId
| where isnull(RegTime) or RegTime between (SafeBootTime - 5m .. SafeBootTime + WindowMinutes)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ShutdownTime, SafeBootTime)
| project SafeBootTime, ShutdownTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          SafeBootParent, SafeBootParentCmd, SafeBootCmd, ShutdownCmd, RegKey, RegVal
| order by SafeBootTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
let SafeBootProc = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe"
    | where CommandLine has "safeboot"

    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\shutdown.exe"
    | where CommandLine has_any ("/r", "-r")
    | project ShutdownTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, ShutdownCmd = CommandLine;
SafeBootProc
| join kind=inner ShutdownProc on Computer
| where ShutdownTime between (SafeBootTime .. SafeBootTime + WindowMinutes)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ShutdownTime, SafeBootTime)
| project SafeBootTime, ShutdownTime, DelaySec, Computer, SubjectUserName,
          SafeBootParent, SafeBootCmd, ShutdownCmd
| order by SafeBootTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LockBit Safe-Mode Boot Configuration Tamper (bcdedit safeboot)
id: 7f4a2c81-9b6d-4e1a-8c3f-5d2e9a1b7c4e
status: experimental
description: Detects LockBit 3.0 / Black anti-AV evasion via bcdedit setting safeboot to network or minimal — the precursor to a forced reboot into Safe Mode where EDR/AV agents do not load, enabling unobstructed encryption.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-165a
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2022/07/21/lockbit-3-0-black-attacks-and-leaks-reveal-wormable-capabilities-and-tooling/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.009
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'safeboot'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'network'
      - 'minimal'
  filter_legit_admin:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\mmc.exe'
      - '\msconfig.exe'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and not filter_legit_admin
falsepositives:
  - Administrators manually configuring Safe Mode for troubleshooting (rare and typically via msconfig)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:4688 OR @EventID:1) @Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE OR *\\BcdEdit.exe) @CommandLine:(*safeboot* OR *SAFEBOOT* OR *SafeBoot*) @CommandLine:(*network* OR *NETWORK* OR *Network* OR *minimal* OR *MINIMAL* OR *Minimal*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)safeboot\\s+(network|minimal)", field=CommandLine)
| join({
    #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\shutdown\.exe$/i
    | regex("(?i)\\s[/-]r(\\s|$)", field=CommandLine)
    | rename(field=@timestamp, as=shutdown_time)
    | rename(field=CommandLine, as=shutdown_cmd)
  }, field=aid, include=[shutdown_time, shutdown_cmd])
| delay_sec := (shutdown_time - @timestamp) / 1000
| delay_sec >= 0 AND delay_sec <= 600
| table([@timestamp, shutdown_time, delay_sec, aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine, shutdown_cmd])
ucs.rationale: Safe-Mode-boot-then-reboot is LockBit's most distinctive defensive evasion — Sophos's 2022 LockBit 3.0 reverse-engineering and CISA AA23-165A both call out the `-safemode` payload flag that triggers exactly this chain: BCD edit → RunOnce/SafeBoot key plant → forced reboot. Legitimate admins virtually never combine `bcdedit safeboot network` with a `shutdown /r` inside 10 minutes from the same proc
